gridShowcase.basicDescription: [ES] Simple data grid with sorting, filtering, and pagination enabled. Click column headers to sort, use the filter row to narrow results.
gridShowcase.groupingDescription: [ES] Grid with group drop area. Drag column headers to the drop zone to group data. Pre-grouped by Department.
gridShowcase.editingDescription: [ES] Click Edit on any row to modify values inline. Use Save to persist or Cancel to discard changes.
gridShowcase.selectionDescription: [ES] Multi-row selection using checkboxes. Select individual rows or use the header checkbox to select all.
gridShowcase.columnFeaturesDescription: [ES] Resize columns by dragging borders, reorder by dragging headers. First column is frozen. Use the Column Chooser to toggle visibility.
gridShowcase.aggregatesDescription: [ES] Footer row showing Sum, Average, and Count aggregates for order data columns.
gridShowcase.toolbarDescription: [ES] Toolbar with search, print, and export buttons. Right-click rows for context menu options.
gridShowcase.detailRowDescription: [ES] Click the expand icon on any row to reveal additional employee details in an expandable panel.
gridShowcase.dragDropDescription: [ES] Drag rows by the handle to reorder them within the grid.
gridShowcase.paginationDescription: [ES] Client-side pagination with configurable page sizes. Use the page size dropdown and navigation buttons to browse data.
gridShowcase.virtualizationDescription: [ES] Renders 1,000 rows efficiently using row virtualization. Only visible rows are rendered in the DOM for optimal performance.
gridShowcase.alertManagementDesc: [ES] Trading-style order management grid with priority badges, settlement tracking, checkbox selection, and searchable toolbar.
gridShowcase.designSpecDesc: [ES] Pixel-perfect static tables matching the DataGrid component at three density levels.
gridShowcase.themeStudioDesc: [ES] DataGrid styled with the Theme Studio dark theme matching production design.
gridShowcase.tableSpecDesc: [ES] All 6 table variants extracted from the component set. Each variant uses pixel-perfect theme overrides matching the API-extracted values.
gridShowcase.selectionToolbarDesc: [ES] Toolbar that appears above the grid showing selected items as removable chips with a clear-all button.
gridShowcase.interactivePlaygroundDescription: [ES] Toggle controls to configure the table in real-time. The state panel and code snippet update as you change settings.
